To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the DSS for strategic management based on the Balanced Score Card model has been implemented successfully, that the system is being used by managers and that the company is benefiting from it in the form of better decision-making and improved performance.
the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) integrated with a Decision Support System ( DSS) can be an effective Strategic Management Tool for an SME.
the BSC model is a useful tool for SME strategic management and the integration of the BSC model with a DSS provides an effective tool for SMEs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a DSS that embodies the BSC model and that enables the analysis and monitoring of strategic performance indicators.
the design of a DSS for the implementation of the Balanced Score Card model in a Portuguese SME.

the following questions: (i) What are the main characteristics of a BSC-based strategic management system for an SME?, (ii) How can the Balanced Scorecard be used as an integrated strategic planning and control tool?, (iii) How can the BSC be integrated with a Dss for strategic management? and (iv) How can a BSC-based DSS be implemented in a SME?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the DSS for strategic management has been a successful tool to support the strategic management of the company and that it has contributed to the company's performance.
the BSC can be an effective tool for strategic management of a SME, if properly adopted and if the DSS is designed to support the strategic decision-making process.
this work demonstrates that a Balanced Scorecard integrated with a DSC can be an effective tool for strategic management for a SME.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the BSC model is a useful strategic management tool that can be effectively supported by a DSS.
the BSC model is a very useful strategic management tool, and that the integration of the BSC model with a DSS is very useful to implement the strategy.
the BSC model, when integrated with a DSC, can be a very useful and effective strategic management tool, especially for an SME.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, although the Balanced Scorecard is a well known model, its adoption in SMEs is a challenging task that requires a careful definition of the strategy and the selection of the appropriate measures.
, by using a DSS, a company can more effectively analyse and monitor the strategic measures of a BSC, and thus more effectively implement its strategy.

, in order to effectively implement the BSC, the strategic measures should be carefully selected, the strategic initiatives to implement them should be well identified and a DSS should be conceived to support the strategic management process.
